## Why

Every inference MUST be visually and structurally distinguishable from
observation on every surface (SIG-RECON-052, verbatim). Before this row
the L4 accountability links were marked only in **prose** ("Derived
accountability link (L4 inference, …)") — a consumer had to parse a
sentence to learn a record was derived. This row lands the typed marker
— `inferred: true` + `layer: "L4"` — as one cross-surface contract,
defined once in `inference.marking` (Python) and mirrored once in
`web/src/lib/epistemic.ts` (TypeScript), so no surface can emit or render
an inference as an observed fact, and a removed or half-stripped marker
fails the conformance test rather than silently degrading
(SIG-ENG-042).

## What ships

- **`inference/src/inference/marking.py`** — the single Python-side
  contract: `INFERRED_LAYER = "L4"` (checked equal to
  `reconcile.model.Inference.layer`), `mark_inferred(record)` (stamps the
  pair on an emitted record) and `is_inferred_record(record)` (true only
  when BOTH fields agree — a half-marker counts as unmarked).
- **Export bytes** (`exports/src/exports/`):
  - `spine_export.py` — `_governance_row` (the dossier section row) and
    `_governance_chain_field` (the structured chain links) emit the
    typed pair alongside the existing prose note — prose supplements,
    never replaces, the marker.
  - `dedup.py` — `DedupView.record_fields` marks the inferential ER
    entries (`possible_duplicates`, the derived `multi_view`
    classification — SIG-CONF-005) while the mechanically-verified
    `copies` stay unmarked.
  - `published_record.py` — `sig.published-record/5`: every released
    record carries the pair on the hashed document (`inferred: false,
    layer: null` on observed records — the distinction is structural,
    never absent-by-convention); `__post_init__` refuses a half-marker.
  - `docs/build/reports/public_surface_contracts.schema.json` — the
    frozen `Row` contract gains the two optional fields (additive).
- **API payloads** (`api/src/api/models.py`) — the `_InferenceMarked`
  base carries `inferred: bool` + `layer: Literal["L4"] | None` with a
  model validator refusing the incoherent pair;
  `ResolutionEnvelope`, `ClaimResponse`, `TaskResponse` and
  `ContradictionResponse` inherit it (`inferred: false, layer: null` —
  spine-layer records are structurally distinguished from L4 facts;
  `extra="forbid"` keeps the wire shape tight).
- **The rendered marker** (`web/`):
  - `epistemic.ts` — `INFERRED_MARKER` (◈ glyph + "Inferred" label +
    `sig-inferred` class + meaning title) and `isInferredRecord` —
    the same coherent-pair contract as the Python side.
  - `epistemic.css` — `.sig-inferred`: a dotted-outline chip, inked by
    the new `--sig-epi-inferred-ink` token (hsl 195deg — outside the
    green band, SIG-UI-006, and distinct from the support/agreement
    ramps). Three non-colour channels: the glyph, the label text, and
    the dotted outline (SIG-UI-005); reads in greyscale and print.
  - `dossier.ts` — `Row` gains optional `inferred`/`layer`; `rowJson`
    emits the pair on the JSON twin.
  - `DossierSection.astro` — a marked row renders the marker before its
    value: `sig-inferred` + `data-inferred="true"` +
    `data-layer="L4"` — pure markup, no script (the page type's T1/no-JS
    parity is preserved; print inherits the same row render).
  - `dossier-fixture.ts` — the worked OKC dossier gains the L4
    governance-chain row the e2e legs assert.
- **The cross-surface conformance test**
  (`tests/exports/test_p36_14_inferred_marker.py`, 8 legs) — one fixture
  inference (a materialized `accountability_link:*`, i.e.
  `inference.derived_fact`) is run through `build_spine_export` and must
  be marked in the **export bytes** (`web/dossiers.json` section rows +
  `governance_chain` links + the raw serialized bytes), in the **API
  payload** (`/v1/dossier` serves the marked rows; `/v1/claim` +
  `/v1/resolution` envelopes carry `inferred: false, layer: null`), and
  against the **frozen web Row contract** (jsonschema). The removal leg
  is intrinsic: `is_inferred_record` demands both fields, every leg
  asserts the marker's presence directly, and a stripped record is shown
  unmarked — an unmarked emission is a red build, never a quiet pass
  (SIG-ENG-042). `web/tests/e2e/inferred-marker{,.nojs}.spec.ts` cover
  the rendered-HTML leg (the `sig-inferred` chip, the glyph, the label,
  `data-layer="L4"` — JS and no-JS, page and print);
  `web/tests/unit/inferred-marker.test.ts` pins the marker contract,
  the non-green token and the coherent-pair rule.

## Deviations / deferrals

1. **Task and contradiction records carry `inferred: false`
   deliberately.** Both are computed on read (each already discloses its
   derivation via `spine_watermark`, P25.10) but neither is an L4
   `derived_fact`; marking them `inferred: true` would conflate "derived
   work item" with "derived *fact*" — exactly the SIG-RECON-031
   distinction the marker exists to keep.
2. **The marker is a field pair, not a Provisional chip** — Provisional
   is the unevaluated-method lexicon label (SIG-UI-062, owner P36.17)
   and Candidate is a lifecycle state; the marker names *what kind of
   record this is* (derived, not observed). The lexicon wording is
   P36.17's; this row lands the structural channel it renders.
3. **Scope of "every export record"** — the marker lands at every seam
   where an L4/inferential value becomes an emitted record today:
   governance-chain rows + links, dedup inferential entries, and the
   published-record projection (which carries the pair on every record,
   observed included). Observed-only artifacts (sites, map layers,
   coverage) are records of observed claims and correctly carry no
   `inferred: true`; the published-record pair makes the distinction
   present even there. Any future export path minting a derived-fact
   record inherits the conformance rule via `is_inferred_record`.
4. **`sig.published-record/4` → `/5` bump** — the marker rides the
   hashed document so an inferred record and an observed record can
   never serialize identically; the version bump records the new field
   honestly (the projection is additive — old `/4` readers ignore the
   new keys, new readers get the distinction).
